title: Jude and the Inheritance
author: August Blackwood
blurb: Tamsin Eriksen, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
